1.mascotDialogue: extract-max is really two motions — swap the root with the last leaf, shrink the heap by one, then let the displaced value sink to wherever it truly belongs.

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 4 and 5 find the largest among the node and its two children. Line 8's recursive call is what allows the displaced value to keep sinking past more than one level, if it must.

3.mascotDialogue: 9 sits at the very top, and every parent below beats both its children — same array-index arithmetic as min heap, only the comparison direction reversed.

4.mascotDialogue: The swap alone does not finish the task. Without siftDown, you have only moved the problem to the top of the tree, not resolved it.
